body.statement: Montiel Olea, Qiu, and Stoye study randomized minimax-regret statistical decision rules under partial identification in a finite-sample Gaussian-likelihood framework.  Their results include multiplicity of minimax-regret rules, an essentially unique least-randomizing refinement, admissibility results, and profiled-regret comparisons.  This source is a direct decision-theoretic antecedent; the present paper does not claim to subsume its finite-sample admissibility, profiled-regret, or least-randomizing theory.
